podcast.body: He was 17 years old when America's hit song "A Horse with No Name" was released in 1971. "Dewey Bennell 17 years old when that song was released."

podcast.body: In a spring 1972 interview, he articulated that the band's members, then aged 18 to 20, were not interested in politics, stating "all that they were into as music." "Dewey Bennell said that nobody in the band ages 18 19 and 20 was political all that they were into as music."
